hook.text: This album is notable for including Strasbourg / St. Denis, a Hargrove composition from its track list.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 19 to 21 September 2007, at Capitol Studios, Los Angeles

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Roy Hargrove (trumpet, flugelhorn), Justin Robinson (alto saxophone, flute), Gerald Clayton (piano), Danton Boller (bass), Montez Coleman (drums)

sentences.text: Before Earfood, Roy Hargrove had made several albums that explored jazz in a hip-hop and R&B setting.
This record was a return to his long-running interest in hard bop.
Al Schmitt recorded and mixed the album, with Steve Genewick as engineer.
Jacques Muyal is credited as executive producer on the record.
